text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I get a summons from Sweep
Tosho. I go
where she tells me, and...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
There you are, Familiar! Now "Magical
Girl ☆
Sweepy 5" can begin!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm Magical Black!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! You see, recently we've been
studying
magic and looking into some
rumors around it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Magical Dia here! ♪ What jinx are we
unmasking
today?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh, how very exciting. What
kind of
experimental drin—I mean...
What kind of magic
potion can Professor
Tachyon provide to assist
you today?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's why you're here, Familiar! It's part
of our
research!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's quite an... eccentric group. Partially
just to
keep an eye on things, I decide
to accompany
them.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, a bird that can grant wishes
has been
spotted around here.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Hold on, Magical Dia! That snake is
after the
bird!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Wait up!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Snake nex ornithogalum... Hear my
words, snake!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Get away from there, now! We have
business with
that bird!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, there it goes. I'm glad that snake
was such
a good listener!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Look at that cool demeanor! As
expected from
the genius Magical Girl
Sweepy!
choice_data_list: （大きな声に驚いただけな気もするけど）

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Next, it's time for potion research! We're
making
a potion that'll make us run
faster!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
We need to gather honey from the

hardest-working bee in its hive and a
fang from a
wolf without a pack.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That won't do. Don't go getting
weak-kneed now!
Sacrifices must be
made in pursuit of great
results! Now
then, let's get to looking for that

beehi—
choice_data_list: 集めるには危険じゃない？

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hooold it! You know you can't race if
you get
stung and come down with a
fever, right?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Don't confuse recklessness with courage!
Every
witch knows that! We need to
come up with a
plan before we do
anything.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
How about this? We put the bees to
sleep and
mark their backs! We can use
those marks to
figure out which one
works the hardest!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm... That's a pretty sound idea. Why
don't I
bring something along to put the
bees to sleep?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shortly after, the Sweepy 5 continue
with their
magical endeavors...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Okay, how about we stop here for
today? Sweepy
5, dismissed!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whew! That was so much fun! Thanks,
Sweep!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. You can thank me by working
hard! You
could do with some study too,
famil—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey! What are you staring at me for?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I was nervous at first about joining the
magical
investigation, but Sweep Tosho
took the initiative
and watched over her
friends. I tell her so, and...
choice_data_list: しっかりリーダーやってるなと思って

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's the big deal? That's what
you're
supposed to do!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm the best witch at this school. It's only
natural
for the strongest witch to take
the lead!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I may still be inexperienced, but
Grandma raised
me well!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
She protected me when I was in trouble
and gave
me advice about being a witch.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And now it's my turn to bring up this
new batch of
witches!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That's a first-class witch's job. Get it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, she's such a cool leader! Don't
you just
want to follow her wherever she
goes?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You can feel her determination as a
leader...
There's a lot that I'd like to
learn from her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. Then, things should remain
interesting.
I'd like to keep obser—ahem!
I mean, may I join
you?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! If you're all gonna beg me, then I
guess I'll
keep looking after you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may seem childish, but she makes
cool,
rational decisions and shows
concern for her
friends. Seeing that side
of her, I think...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may seem childish, but she makes
cool,
rational decisions and shows
concern for her
friends. Seeing that side
of her, I think...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: A what?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I get it! You're cool and dependable...
kind of like
a queenpin!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! Call me a great and powerful
witch!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Criminals and witches are totally
different!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, no kidding! Who do you think
you're
talking to?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You really do think about us so much,
Sweep.
Don't you think it's nice your
trainer realizes it
too? ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hm, well... I guess you could say it's a
good
opportunity to see how much of a
genius I am!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Got that? As the familiar of a genius
magical girl,
you need to keep your
mind sharp too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As soon as she says that, she strides off.
She may
still have some room to grow,
but I'm glad to see
that she cares so
deeply for her friends.
